shortDescription: The Trump administration plans to designate more than two dozen artificial intelligence companies, including Nvidia NASDAQ:NVDA, Amazon NASDAQ:AMZN, Microsoft NASDAQ:MSFT, OpenAI NASDAQ:OPENAI, and Anthropic NASDAQ:ANT, as U.S. “national champions” to help them expand overseas and compete with Chin…

children: The Trump administration plans to designate more than two dozen artificial intelligence companies, including Nvidia
, as U.S. “national champions” to help them expand overseas and compete with Chinese rivals,
reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the plans.
The announcement could come as early as this week, with Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick expected to unveil the initiative, although the timing could change, according to the report.
Companies selected for the designation could receive expedited export-license approvals, government support for their overseas operations, and access to federal financing.

The initiative builds on the American AI Exports Program, established through a July 2025 executive order directing the Commerce Department to promote US AI exports through integrated packages combining chips, data infrastructure, AI models, and related technologies.

The Commerce Department began implementing the program in October 2025 and invited companies to submit proposals in April 2026. It received 78 applications, with final selections subject to interagency review.
The proposed designations are part of Washington's broader effort to expand global adoption of US AI technology and compete with China. The
also reported that the administration is preparing separate measures to prevent advanced chips from being diverted to China, while Lutnick is expected to accompany Trump on his upcoming China visit.

title: Trump eyes 'national champion' status for Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft and other AI firms - report
